prompt:
[Animation Style]

3D cartoon rendering in a chibi / Q-version cute aesthetic. Soft subsurface scattering (SSS) on skin for a porcelain-smooth, slightly translucent look. Advanced fur simulation: the black areas of the onesie use short, dense micro-plush fibers; the white belly area uses longer, fluffier pile that deforms and wobbles naturally with body movement. The pale pink scarf has a realistic knit-cashmere texture with fine weave detail. Soft global illumination with a warm-cool contrast — warm key light on the character, cool blue ambient bounce from the snow. Gentle depth-of-field, cinematic but cozy atmosphere. Render quality: high-fidelity CGI, Pixar-adjacent polish, no outline strokes, no flat shading.

[Expression Control]

Facial expressions stay subtle and restrained throughout the first half of the video. The smile is always a gentle closed-lip smile with only slightly upturned corners — never a wide grin, never an open-mouth laugh, never bared teeth in the opening seconds. The mouth stays small and soft; any laugh or giggle is conveyed through the eyes and a quiet closed-mouth smile rather than a large open mouth. Full happy expressions are saved for the second half and remain modest.

[Character Reference]

Reference the character from <图片1>: large brown-red eyes, black blunt bangs bob-cut hair, round face with soft pink cheek blush, small penguin hair clip at the hairline. Full-body black penguin mascot onesie with white long-pile belly fur, yellow beak and round eyes on the hood. Pale pink cashmere scarf wrapped around the neck with the tail end draping naturally. Yellow penguin-flipper shoes. Do NOT use the pure white background or three-view layout from the reference image.

[Subject & Consistency]

A single chibi girl (approx. 2.5 head-body ratio, rounded silhouette) wearing the complete penguin onesie outfit. Maintain the onesie structure, plush material differentiation, pink scarf color, and flipper shoes throughout. Only one character on screen at all times.

[Scene]

A lively city fountain plaza on a warm summer afternoon. A wide circular stone fountain gurgles softly in the center, its spray glittering against the bright blue sky. Sunlight dapples through the leaves of a few young maple trees around the plaza. Pigeons peck at crumbs near the benches, and a couple of distant kids laugh in the background. Warm golden sunlight, long soft shadows, sparkling water droplets catching the light, gentle summer breeze.

[Dialogue & Sound Design]

Girl's voice: young, soft, cheerful, slightly breathy child-like voice; speaks in Chinese.

Environment: gentle fountain water, summer breeze in the leaves, faint city hum, distant pigeons cooing.

BGM: light ukulele plucks with a soft woodblock rhythm, warm and sunny, low volume throughout.

[Timeline — Total 10s]

0.0s – 2.5s — Discovering the fountain

The girl walks into the sunny plaza, hands in her onesie's pouch pockets, and notices the big fountain sparkling in the light. She stops and looks up at the dancing water with a small, gentle closed-lip smile, her mouth relaxed and barely curved, corners only slightly turned up, her penguin hood's beak bobbing. She takes a slow, curious step toward the stone edge.
Girl (soft, curious): 「哇——好漂亮的水柱！」
Sound: light footsteps on warm stone, soft water gurgle, a few pigeons cooing. Light ukulele begins.
Camera: medium shot at eye level from behind the fountain, slow push-in, sparkling water spray glowing in the sunlight.

2.5s – 5.0s — Testing the water

She crouches at the stone edge, dips one flipper-shoe foot toward the water, then pulls it back quickly with a quiet, closed-mouth giggle as a tiny spray lands on her foot. She reaches out and lets her hand trail through the shallow fountain pool, water rippling around her flipper glove, a calm focused expression and a small relaxed smile on her face.
Girl (playful, soft): 「凉凉的耶！嘿嘿～」
Sound: gentle splash, water trickling, a small happy exhale, woodblock taps accenting.
Camera: low-angle side shot capturing her crouched pose and the rippling water, shallow depth-of-field on the plaza behind.

5.0s – 7.5s — Splashing joyfully

She stands, cups both flipper hands, scoops up water and tosses it playfully toward the fountain spray, scattering a small shimmering arc of droplets in the sunlight. She lets out a warm, gentle laugh, eyes curving into a soft happy smile, water beading on her black plush fur. The pink scarf sways gently as she moves.
Girl (laughing softly): 「哈哈哈——水花好好玩！」
Sound: cheerful splashing, droplets falling like little bells, light bubbling laughter. BGM peaks gently.
Camera: tracking shot circling slightly around her, capturing the tossing motion and sparkling droplets, warm backlight through the water spray.

7.5s – 10.0s — Happy penguin by the fountain

She stands beside the fountain, hands clasped behind her back, looking at the water with a warm, modest smile. She lifts one hand to wave toward the fountain spray as if greeting it, then turns to the camera with a calm, happy smile and a tiny bow, a small rainbow shimmer visible in the mist behind her.
Girl (content, proud): 「企鹅也喜欢喷泉！嘿嘿～」
Sound: water gurgling gently, a soft satisfied exhale, light giggles, distant pigeons. BGM resolves into a warm sunny chord and fades.
Camera: wide medium shot from the plaza, girl in the foreground, fountain spray and tiny rainbow in soft focus behind her. Warm key light on her face, cheek blush visible. Final frame holds on her quiet happy smile.

[Consistency Lock]

Keep the girl's identity and count (single character only), penguin onesie material and structure (short black plush + long white belly pile), scarf color and knit texture, flipper-shoe appearance, and the summer fountain plaza scene consistent across all time segments. No extra characters, no costume changes, no style shifts mid-video. Voice remains the same young soft cheerful tone throughout.
